- **Re-read on `origin/main` `2054a0888c`:** `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:5155` and `:5179` (reminder) and `:6540` (SLA) still build `${raw.object_name}/${raw.record_id}`. The filed reading holds.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, the approval-notification `body` strings that still build `${raw.object_name}/${raw.record_id}`. The seat re-read them on `5c2ac83a23`:
  - the card's three: `approval.reminder` at `:5175` and `:5199`, and `approval.sla_breached` at `:6561`;
  - five more of the same family that ruling B of #23556 / #23594 also governs: `:4809` (revision limit exceeded), `:4853` (needs rework), `:5115` (now an approver), `:6542` (escalated to you) and `:6575` (escalation action taken).
- The test beside it, for the pin.
- One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`.
Exclusions:
- ⛔ Not `:4900`'s `DUPLICATE_REQUEST` refusal text: it is an error message, not a notification body, and a different surface.
- ⛔ Not `nameSubjectRecord` itself (`:7044`), nor `objectLabelOf`. Reuse them as they stand.
- ⛔ Not `sys-approval-request.object.ts` (#24007 is next on it). ⛔ Nothing in `packages/spec`.
Container & model: `S: eight body strings in one file onto the one ruled helper, one pin ⇒ S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`TIER_DEFAULT`; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this surface: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no. Notification body text changes from `object_name/record_id` to the ruled label-and-id form. No export, type, accept set or served column moves.
Responsibility: `plugin-approvals (this lane): every approval notification body names its subject record through nameSubjectRecord (object label and id, no title), as ruling B of #23556 / #23594 sets | approval.requested already does | the console renders the body as sent`
Thread-read: `6219520810`
Ruling-ref: #23594 ruling B (via #23556), as `nameSubjectRecord`'s docblock records it.
Serial constraints:
- No open PR touches `approval-service.ts`. #23889 (PR #23984) landed at 20:43Z.
- #24007 (`sys-approval-request.object.ts`) is `pm:blocked` and is not in flight.
Premise to falsify first: each of the eight sites still builds the slash form on `origin/main`, and `nameSubjectRecord` answers `label id` (or `object id` with no label) for the same arguments. Read each site's `raw` to confirm `object_name` and `record_id` are its subject.

**The dev's `open_questions[0]` (report on this card), answered: A.** The file surface keeps `approval-service.ts` and gains two sites in it.
- **The sites:** `approval.ooo_substituted` (`:3624`) and `approval.ooo_skipped` (`:3636`) in `openNodeRequest`. Both built `${input.object}/${input.recordId}`, the same rendered slash form under a variable spelling the claim's search missed.
- **The fix:** they now call the same `nameSubjectRecord` the method already calls at `:3691`. They are kept in PR #24064 (commit `a42511d0ac`).
- **Why A:** the card's Done-when names every approval notification body, and the battery's slash sweep now reds any body that regresses.
- **Re-read by the seat at the PR head.** No notification body in the file still builds the slash form. The nine that remain are refusal texts and log lines (`DUPLICATE_REQUEST`, `NO_APPROVERS`, the `[approvals]` warnings), a different surface, out of this card's scope.

**The dev's other finding is filed separately.** The two out-of-office bodies name the PERSON by raw `sys_user` id (`… while u_ooo is out of office`), which is not this card's record-naming family. The seat files it as a carrier card.
